name: Humanoid (baseline)
notes: Baseline for people and people-shaped creatures: human guards, smugglers and the harbour watch, goblins, Brother Horn. Tuning band: sight far range 15–30 m and hearing threshold 20–40 dB (a creature needing values outside it should override, not edit this file). Far 20 m and primary half-angle 35° match the e11.5 perception tests; the 80° periphery is a human's useful side vision, and 40° vertical keeps a thief on a high beam unseen until the guard looks up. Dark vision 0.2: people need light, which is what makes the thief's shadows work. Hearing 30 dB (quiet-room level) catches a careless step at a few metres but not a crouched one. No smell or special senses. Goblins, who see in the dark, override darkVision.
